alignment: Piecewise affine screenshot-time mapping: original pre-drop stroke to start..both-node plateau; post-drop noisy positive stroke to plateau..last terminal Cassandra drop. Explicit zeros thereafter.
noise: Raster fluctuations preserved. No invented noise-change event during response-time growth.
event_detection: First failure: final run of node1 values<0.1ms. Plateau: first >=25ms sample with next20min median>=25 and >=80% samples>=21ms. Terminal edge: first sample after last>=20ms of each node. These are graph markers, not outage logs.
limitations: Approximate raster reconstruction. Legend is absent; identifiers are colors. Faint/overlapping gray, olive, teal and orange lines are less precise than the dominant green/yellow traces. Unresolvable teal columns use visually estimated 30 TPS before and 10 TPS after the partial drop.
